thread:
maya: Heads up — I'm putting together the release blurb for the docs deploy tomorrow 09:00 PT. Draft is in PR #7890. Need quick checks: announcement copy, example snippets, and a short known-issues note.

alex: On it. Which snippets do you want verified? SDK JS or Python?

maya: Both. Main things: updated streaming example for chat, and the embeddings snippet that mentions batch embeddings. Also one curl example we added for the reranking demo.

sam: I can sanity-check the Python SDK examples. Noticed one `client.generate()` call in the draft that needs to use `client.chat.completions.create()` in v2.

maya: Yep that's the one. Thanks. I'll mark it in the PR with a TODO.

alex: Quick note on permalinks: earlier migration broke a handful of anchor links for the Optimize guide. I flagged them in #7901. We should add redirect rules before publish.

tj: Redirect rules we can deploy to CDN. Liz — can you add the path map? We need /docs/optimize#cache -> /docs/optimize#caching and a general rule for /docs/v0/* -> /docs/v1/*.

liz: Copying the rule: `rewrite "/docs/v0/(.*)" "/docs/v1/$1" permanent;` Adding to infra config now. Will roll with the next edge deploy.

maya: Fantastic. For announcement copy, two short bullets (feature + cost/perf note) and one callout for known issue (streaming embeddings sometimes truncate with SDK v2 under low-latency batch). Draft below: 
- Feature: streaming chat + function call improvements (see examples).
- Performance: smarter batching reduces token cost by up to 30% for common workloads.
- Known issue: streaming embeddings may truncate on < 50ms batch windows with some GPU kernels; fallback to synchronous embed call recommended.

sam: Reword the known issue slightly — suggest "may produce truncated vectors" and include a quick mitigation snippet.

maya: Good call. Adding mitigation snippet: 
```
# Python (sync fallback)
from redwood import Client
client = Client()
emb = client.embeddings.create(model="embed-v2", input=["..."], sync=True)
```

alex: LGTM. I ran the JS examples — fixed one var -> const and an async/await mismatch. Pushed small patch to #7890.

docs-bot: Mention: docs-prbot assigned reviewers: @alex @sam @liz for PR #7890 — please review within 24h.

tj: Also flagging the changelog: we should add a short compatibility blurb for Dedicated vs Hosted routing changes in case customers see routing fallbacks. Small paragraph under Breaking changes.

maya: I'll draft that. Proposed blurb: "Routing policy changes may cause requests to fall back to compatible variants when pinned models are unavailable; check rollout policy in Console." Keep it one sentence?

sam: One sentence is fine. Maybe add an example link to Console docs.

maya: Added link: https://redwood.example.com/console/rollouts — will replace with prod URL at publish.

liz: Redirect rule deployed to staging. I'll run linkcheck once staging builds.

alex: Final ask — anyone spot any API surface in the docs that references `openai` package by accident? I found one in the rerank page. Fixed in #7902.

maya: Thanks. If reviewers sign off in the next 2 hours I'll merge and tag release-notes:docs.

sam: Reviewing now.

alex: Reviewed + approved.

liz: Linkcheck on staging shows 2 warnings (one anchor still missing, one external 404). Sending PR to fix anchors.

maya: Perfect. If all green I'll do the final copy push. :thumbsup:
